ownerRules.newPhysicalRequires: higher generation, or higher sessionGeneration on the same generation and connectionGeneration
ownerRules.sceneChange: reset preserves pending; old reserved tokens fail validate and enter
ownerRules.retire: actual session retirement clears all and tombstones the old physical owner

setViewer.payload: ordinary UserInformation payload with name and realId, optionally nested info

snapshot.inventoryJson: InventoryModel object from the shared projection, never a string or inventoryItems array

reserve.deadlineMs: rename only: caller supplies the Native nowMs + 5000 deadline

enter.command: exact reserved DTO; only at the final socket boundary

cancelUnsent.token: reserved token only; entered is never refunded

expire.nowMs: monotonic safe integer; only Native rename strictly-after-deadline expiry

response.kind: Native serde lowerCamel kind or null
response.released: local custody tokens retired by Native completion, scope retirement, expiry or session retirement; never an economic success ACK
response.error: fixed finite code only when ok=false

entryOrder: complete all source and immutable DTO checks
validate budget token before any irreversible domain claim
perform only synchronous callback-free domain claims
socket.send; transport throw retains entered custody
staleAfterDomainClaim: conservatively reject socket entry; budget token remains reserved and can cancelUnsent; do not clear another entered authority ledger or invent a receipt
invites: Native inviter and epoch are always captured internally from real packets; UI proof epochs remain entirely outside this bridge

nativeUiTransients.source: overlays.rs keyboard push_intent and button push_transient_unique
trade_dialog.rs Invitation reply uses push_transient_unique for accept and decline

legacyGuildInfo: requestGuildInfo upgrades to GuildRosterRead, with no duplicate slot
